meaning: Prospective index-to-detection audit. The index is danger, not ignition probability; outcome points are active-fire observations, not verified ignitions.

protocol.source_observation: INPE daily South America active-fire CSV, all listed sensors, country Argentina
protocol.issue_time: GeoTIFF creation_date embedded in the captured forecast
protocol.target_window: [forecast_valid_utc, forecast_valid_utc + 24 hours), UTC; detections before validity are excluded
protocol.spatial_unit: complete trail polyline within 10 km; local planar point-to-segment distance
protocol.matured_observation_heuristic: For every UTC date touched by the target window, HTTP Last-Modified >= following date 06:00 UTC
protocol.metrics: No precision/recall is computed. Absence of a listed point is not a verified no-fire outcome.

limitations: A satellite point can represent an existing fire first detected after forecast validity, not a new ignition after validity.
The daily CSV has no per-route observation mask; no listed point cannot prove absence of fire.
Fire detections are evaluated against full trail lines, while the danger index values are still sampled at fixed route-sector centers.
Many sensors and points may refer to one fire; detections are not independent fire episodes.
Risk index values are not calibrated probabilities.
